generate_inputs_and_wrap_model: build a wrapped MMDetection model and sample inputs ready for ONNX export from a config and checkpoint
build_model_from_cfg: build an MMDetection model from an OpenMMLab config file and load weights from a checkpoint path
preprocess_example_input: preprocess an example input image into a normalized tensor and metadata dict for model inference
test_generate_inputs_and_wrap_model: test the generate_inputs_and_wrap_model function by exporting a wrapped MMDetection model to ONNX format
review_preprocess_example_input: review the preprocess_example_input function to verify image resizing, normalization, and tensor conversion logic
